subject: design/feature-draft
statement: A reopened draft lock issues only new and changed units against the binding lock, supersedes changed rows and contract text, and revokes removed rows while retaining prior history.
intent: Make each locked version readable as a complete contract while keeping unchanged records stable.
rationale: Comparison uses the active record at each binding address and the identities of related records; historical problems, brainstorms, reviews, and events use distinct addresses across versions.
fit_criterion: A real Git fixture locks two versions, accepts a PRD-only change, and renders each lock; diff fixtures cover changed, removed, and new rows, answer transitions, history retention, and a blocker-free memory packet.
